provenance.dimension_basis: manufacturer model overall and cavity dimensions
provenance.hidden_structure: hinge and latch internal dimensions inferred; no OEM service geometry asserted

review.frame_coverage: 1023 retained source frames, 115:1138, at 30000/1001 fps. Input and output both decoded to 1023 frames.
review.visual_review: All nine encoded shot review boards inspected for the full v003 sequence; unchanged frames reused with recorded provenance. Corrected shot boards 2 and 3 and eleven additional encoded opening frames inspected in v007. Source free-edge overlays and timer observations inspected.
review.revision: Native v043: recessed control membrane, rounded dial cap, ceramic floor height, curved handle, right cavity lamp strip and pressed liner borders. Animation v007 adds two short opening actions and corrects the macro camera depth; earlier macro attempts retained as rejected work.
review.mechanics: Four visible door-opening sequences use one physical vertical hinge and source-frame motion. 45 visible free-edge frames measured; offscreen portions and static states explicitly inferred. Timer indicator activation follows first visible source evidence.
review.dial_limit: The dial is rotationally symmetric with no identifiable index. Absolute rotation and activation hidden by the hand are inferred; visible indicator changes are preserved.
review.geometry: Native v043 manifold, positive cabinet volume, independent door, recessed control and feet checks passed. Structural surfaces had no intersections at 13 sampled door angles from 0 to 120 degrees, excluding hinge and latch coupling contacts. No continuous clearance proof.
review.alignment_limit: Camera depth, focus, small label artwork, reflected light and hidden construction remain approximate. Manual edge guidance and per-frame registration do not establish pixel-perfect accuracy for every frame. Humans, food and the filming environment are outside the accepted scope.
review.scene: Frozen Tangyuan kitchen staging and shared external lights; internal cavity lamp energy and focus settings inferred from visible operating state.
